profile.headline: Software Engineer with 30 years experience. Looking for Full Time or Contract position. Located in Sunnyvale California. Java / Python / bash / C++. Please e-mail first with job requirements details.
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer II - AR Platform Lab, Mobile Platform Solutions
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with diverse background including cloud services, mobile, test automation.

Skills include Java, C++, Linux, Google Cloud, computer vision, OpenCV, JUnit, J2SE, Object-Oriented programming, debugging, quality assurance, QA, testing, mobile devices, HTML, XML.

Has provided technical leadership to small teams of colleagues and contractors (local and remote).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II - AR Platform Lab, Mobile Platform Solutions
positions.description:
•	Augmented Reality / Computer Vision research + development.  Linux, C++, OpenCV library, CMake
•	Developed tool with C++/OpenCV and corner detection to compare scale of checkerboard images
•	Created Android prototype/demo mobile apps (Java/C++) for Augmented Reality proof-of-concept
•	Added C++ logic via Pybind11 integration layer to teammate’s Python-based GUI application
•	Experimented with uses of Google’s ARCore framework (Java/C++) on Android mobile phones
•	Automated builds / releases with GitHub Actions, YAML files, for AR Passthrough Headset project
positions.insights: Skills: Data Structures · Test Planning · C++ · Git · Shell Scripting · Troubleshooting · Linux · Software Testing · JUnit · Java · GitHub · CMake · OpenCV

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Mobile Computing Lab, Mobile Platform Solutions
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	(11/2016 - 12/2019) Development of web application with backend business logic - new features and bug fixes - tool used by Samsung engineers located in multiple countries:
    o	Developed with Java 7/8, Google Web Toolkit (GWT), Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
    o	Used by Samsung engineers to track Android versions, compatibility test results, Google approvals
    o	Added feature to map mobile carriers with associated countries
    o	Added features for uploading test waiver files and storing in Persistent Objects and Google Sheets
    o	Maintained Android mobile application used to gather device / OS information, property values
    o	Worked with QA to introduce new Selenium-based Web UI test automation
    o	Developed and tested new REST APIs for accessing server features from other clients

•	(2015 - 2016) Developed new server backend (Java/Spring/Hibernate/MySQL), unreleased mobile applications

•	(2013 - 2014) Created QA test automation (Java/JUnit) of server REST APIs of unreleased social media platform
positions.insights: Skills: JUnit · Java · Google Web Toolkit (GWT) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Online Services Division, Information Platform Experiences, Channels/Feeds Team (2012-2013):

o	Developed an internal C#/.NET-based web service to receive and parse HTTP POST requests, insert data in a SQL database maintained by another Microsoft team, and respond to the client.  The combination was an automated e-mail notification system.
o	With one teammate, developed a Functional Test Framework used for writing automated black box tests of a Feeds Web Service.  Use the framework to add tests of Web APIs such as subscribing and unsubscribing to feeds such as flight status or sports scores updates.
o	Learned about deploying, logging, and monitoring/alerts in the environment used for Bing and related cloud services.  Worked with my team to create prototype or early stage cloud services and share knowledge with the team.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
Speech at Microsoft (2010-2012):

o	Worked with a small team to implement and test a Feedback Loop (FBL) Capture Module for the SpeechBox 3.0 service.  Used C#/.NET to transfer speech-related data from binary logs to MS SQL database tables.  Designed and created tables wrote code to insert to the database, and created Unit Tests and Basic Verification Tests.
o	Developed a plug-in for testing a new Conversational Understanding (CU) service, adapting a Client Simulator tool used by the Speech test teams.  The plug-in acted as a client for the CU service using a new protocol, by sending simulated speech inputs, receiving responses and storing them for analysis.  Assisted in creating test cases for the tool.
o	Tested the scalability of a Conversational Understanding service deployed in Windows Azure by sending multiple client requests in parallel using the simulator tool mentioned above via wrapper scripts I wrote (CMD, PowerShell) and analyzed results.
o	Fixed bugs in the FBL system, and reported and investigated bugs in the CU service.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test II
positions.description:
Windows Phone Application Studio (WPAS) (2010):

o	Ported unit tests from Java/JUnit to C#/.NET for a Windows Phone version of the Amazon Kindle e-reader application
o	Member of a test automation focus group to identify, learn about, and share information within WPAS about techniques for automating tests of Windows Phone 7 applications.  Also learned about Windows Phone application development technologies including Silverlight.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test II
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, CA and Billerica, MA
positions.description:
Danger, Inc. was acquired by Microsoft in April 2008.  After completing work on the Sidekick, I joined the Microsoft
Premium Mobile Experiences, KIN Services Test Team (2009-2010):

o	Developed automated tests (C#/.NET) to verify functionality and APIs of the Third Party Integration Library used by the KIN Service for integrating with social networking sites (e.g. Facebook, Twitter, etc.).  The KIN Service was a homegrown cloud service used briefly by KIN cell phones sold by Microsoft/Verizon.
o	Tests categories primarily included white box / unit tests and fuzz tests (related to handling malformed data), as well as some integration (end user, black box type) testing
o	Provided technical guidance and leadership for a team of contractors from China and India who assisted in adding automated tests, filing bugs, and related quality assurance tasks.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Quality Assurance
positions.description:
Sidekick Device Test Team :

* Created automated tests in Java (J2SE/J2ME, JUnit) to verify functionality and APIs of libraries
* Tested OS/library software (audio, video, file I/O, graphical user interface (GUI)) that ran on Danger Hiptop, aka T-Mobile Sidekick mobile devices.  In addition to API tests, also contributed to development of an interactive test app of GUI controls.
* Provided technical guidance and assigned tasks (via e-mail) to contractors located in eastern Europe who assisted us
* Developed an internal test tool for counting and reporting # of test cases vs. library classes/methods
* Developed an internal test tool for testing data synchronization between mobile phone and cloud
* Found and reported bugs, added regression tests, retested and verified fixed bugs
positions.insights: Skills: Test Planning · Shell Scripting · JUnit

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
* Created automated white box tests in Java (J2SE/J2ME, JUnit) to verify functionality of data networking (TCP/IP) features in a new operating system for cellular phones
* Wrote QA test plan documents and developed specific test cases for manual and automated tests of Bluetooth, USB, GPRS, and other networking technologies

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Tester (Independent Contractor)
positions.description:
* Performed manual / black box testing of a Web-based administration/accounting software used by mental health industry
* Updated test plan documents with step-by-step procedures
* Wrote detailed bug reports describing problems found

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cabletron Systems split into Aprisma Management Technologies and other companies.

o	Developed new functionality, enhanced existing features, and resolved problems in SNMP-based network management software
o	Supported network devices from multiple vendors for general releases and custom requests
o	Mentored junior engineers, reviewed the work of peers, and assisted coworkers with Spectrum, source control, build/install and UNIX and Windows NT platform issues
o	Technical Skills Used: C/C++, ksh/bash/sh;  Purify, Great Circle (memory leak debugging);  Microsoft Visual Studio (as debugging tool);  UNIX (Solaris, Cygwin32), Windows NT / 2000

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
o	Developed and enhanced software configuration management tools and processes, increased reliability of the build process
o	Automated many of the daily build tasks that were once done manually
o	Diagnosed build failures, configured machines, incrementally rebuilt and patched build errors
o	Technical Skills Used:  ksh/bash/sh, perl/CGI, HTML;  Sablime (source control, bug tracking, build management), gmake/Makefiles;  UNIX (SunOS/Solaris, IRIX, others), Windows NT
